Subject: Redwood onboarding — MSA redlines + portal contact

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're ready to move to the portal activation step but have a few asks so legal can sign off cleanly. Attached is our standard PO template and a shortlist of contract comments we flagged during review. Two items to call out:

- Signer delegation: our treasury team needs to confirm whether Redwood can accept delegated PO signers for orders under $100k.
- Order form field mapping: we have custom billing codes that must map to your PO metadata (GL code + department).

Can you confirm who on Redwood's side will own the MSA redline negotiation and who will be the operations contact for portal field mapping? Also, any preferred evidence bundle for KYC/procurement can be shared as a single zip.

I've attached: ProcureX_PO_Template.csv (CSV) and a short summary PDF (ProcureX_Redline_Summary.pdf).

Appreciate a note on timelines — procurement would like activation in the next 10 business days if possible.

Thanks,
Anita Singh
Head of Procurement
ProcureX Systems

Attachments: ProcureX_PO_Template.csv (csv), ProcureX_Redline_Summary.pdf (pdf)

Hi all —

I've completed an initial pass on the ProcureX redlines. Summary of the material items and proposed positions below:

1) Delegated signers for POs <$100k — acceptable with a delegation roster and a notarized company policy. We'll accept delegated signers if the roster is provided during onboarding and the names match the portal account.

2) Data retention & audit logs — ProcureX requested 7 years; our standard is 3 years with an option to extend on dedicated/private deployments. Recommend: keep the 3-year default in MSA and add an Order Form option to extend retention (ops to implement flag).

3) Indemnity carve-outs — redline preserves Redwood's standard, but I'll add a limited customer remediation clause to address data processing incidents.

4) PO field mapping / billing codes — legal doesn't object to adding custom fields; ops needs to confirm the maximum field length and whether GL codes can be enumerated.

Attached: MSA_redlines_ProcureX_v3.pdf (annotated) and OrderForm_SignerMatrix.xlsx (template for mapping signers to departments).

Timing: I can finalize a clean MSA + Order Form for signature by Monday EOD (May 17) if ops (Mateo) confirms the field mapping constraints today.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_redlines_ProcureX_v3.pdf (pdf), OrderForm_SignerMatrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi team,

Quick ops notes after looking at ProcureX's samples:

- The ProcureX_PO_Template.csv maps cleanly to our enrollment fields except for 'billing_subdept' (ProcureX uses a 12-char code; Redwood currently stores up to 8 chars). We can accept longer codes but need a schema change in the staging DB and a small UI tweak. ETA: 3 business days to push to staging, 7 business days to production if approved.

- Delegated signer flow: Redwood Supports signer delegation. To automate matching, we'll require the 'signer_id' column in the CSV and an initial roster upload during enrollment. I've attached a sample mapping and the OrderForm_SignerMatrix.xlsx.

- DocuSign + portal handshake: we can send an automated DocuSign envelope once MSA is countersigned. Please confirm the primary legal signer name and email for ProcureX so I can pre-seed the envelope.

Blocked items for ops:
1) Prod schema change approval (I need a ticket).
2) Confirm primary signer and whether ProcureX wants an 'order-approver' role distinct from billing contact.

I'll create a Jira ticket and drop the link here when it's open. If legal signs off tonight, ops can start the staging deploy tomorrow.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Director, Customer Integrations
Redwood Inference
